clusters.neutral_headline: Caregiver creep: how helping elderly relatives can snowball into a full-time job

items.title: Caregiver creep: how helping elderly relatives can snowball into a full-time job
items.standfirst: Assisting an ageing loved one can start with small tasks but may lead to full-time caregiving that requires more supportHelping an ageing parent or loved one often begins with easy-to-field requests: Pick up a prescription. Drive them to a doctor’s appointment. Grab groceries.However, light tasks – just “helping out” here and there – may eventually snowball into the avalanche of full-time caregiving, a phenomenon becoming known as “caregiver creep”. Like “caregiver burnout”, it’s not a formal term, but there is growing awareness about this slow build among healthcare providers and experts. Continue reading...

items.title: Sweden ends aid to Liberia in a hammer blow to women’s rights and healthcare
items.standfirst: Sexual and reproductive services face an uncertain future as the country’s second-largest donor halts support worth hundreds of millions of poundsThe Swedish flag is still flying above the pale blue building overlooking the Atlantic in Liberia’s capital, Monrovia, but the doors of the embassy are now closed to visitors.
